options.summary: Write results back to the first input file
options.detail: The first input must be a file. With multiple files, the combined results replace the first file. Later files keep their original contents. Evaluation errors and an unsuccessful --exit-status leave the destination intact. Split output is incompatible. On Linux, editing a symlink replaced the link and preserved its target in both tested releases. In a writable directory, 4.44.3 can replace a read-only file. Version 4.54.3 rejects that edit. Short spelling: -i.
